sentence_stem: Had the committee been better informed,
correct_completion: the decision would have been very different.
full_sentence: Had the committee been better informed, the decision would have been very different.
acceptable_variants: the vote might have gone another way.

options.text: the committee would have been informed earlier.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea of being informed but does not express the result that the inverted conditional requires.

options.text: the decision is going to be made tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: The present and future tense do not match the unreal past meaning set up by 'had been informed'.

options.text: the decision would have been very different.
they will inform the committee soon.
options.why_wrong: This is a future plan, while the stem is a hypothetical past condition, so it cannot complete the sentence logically.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional (Had + subject + past participle)
explanation: The stem uses an inverted third conditional, which replaces 'if' with 'had' at the start of the clause. The main clause must therefore use 'would have' plus a past participle to describe the imagined result.
translation: Якби комітет був краще поінформований, рішення було б зовсім іншим.
